title: Honda to invest $3 billion in new vehicle assembly plant in Ohio - CNBC
description: The Japanese automaker said the plant will focus on hybrid vehicles and is expected to begin production in 2029.

title: Freedom Caucus lays out legislative priorities for lame-duck session - Politico
description: The conservative group is also pushing GOP leaders to not leave Capitol Hill until the list of demands is met.

title: Nvidia's stock slides as questions swirl around Jensen Huang's future as CEO - CBS News
description: Investors are questioning whether Huang's future as Nvidia's CEO may be at risk amid allegations that he was targeted in a Chinese intelligence operation.

title: Sony Officially Announces New Playstation Handheld - Polygon.com
description: Sony announced a new version of the PlayStation Portal with internal storage, but it's Japan-exclusive.

title: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault - NPR
description: Russell Brand, who became a celebrity darling in the early 2000s, was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women.
